sections.label: FEATURES
sections.title: Stay in the zone.
intro: Everything you need to build an aerobic base, and nothing you don't.

items.title: Live zone feedback
items.text: Your Apple Watch shows your heart rate zone as you run, with a tap on the wrist when you drift out of Zone 2 and when you're back in.

items.title: The MAF method, built in
items.text: 180 minus your age gives your MAF heart rate. Run Easy sets your zones from it, using your age from Apple Health if you like.

items.title: Training insights
items.text: Zone time, cardiac drift, heart rate recovery and weekly training load show your aerobic fitness improving.

items.title: iPhone and Apple Watch
items.text: Record runs on your wrist. Review history, goals and training plans on your iPhone. Runs sync on their own.

items.title: Widgets and Live Activities
items.text: Your week and streak on the Home Screen, and your current run on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

items.title: Private by design
items.text: No account, no ads, no analytics. Your runs and health data stay on your iPhone and Apple Watch.

cta.title: Start running easier.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
